notes: DISsection of COronary arteries - SCAD registry. Conservative better (10.2% MACE vs 25%, p=0.001). PCI complications frequent (wire can extend dissection). Conservative standard unless ongoing ischemia.
Post-SCAD secondary prevention. Beta-blockers reduced recurrent SCAD (9.3% vs 22.0%, p=0.01). May reduce shear stress. Long-term BB recommended.
Acute SCAD management. DAPT: NO benefit over aspirin alone (17.3% vs 16.3%, p=0.83). But increased bleeding (8% vs 2%). DAPT not routinely needed for SCAD unless stented.

SCAD patients screened for FMD. 52% had FMD (renal/cervical arteries). FMD screening changed management (BP control, imaging surveillance). FMD-SCAD patients: 10.6% events vs 8.7% no-FMD. Routine screening recommended.
Young women post-SCAD. Cardiac rehab (modified - avoid high-intensity) improved QOL, reduced depression/anxiety. Recurrent SCAD 7.9% vs 19.4% (p=0.02). Psychosocial support critical.
